name: Macintosh SE ROM B2E362A8 - PiStorm/Emu68 patches
notes: 0x4004A0): each dbf loop counts d0.w down from 0xFFFF until VIA timer 2 interrupts
(vector $64 -> 0x400460 / 0x40049A) or d0.w wraps to -1 after 65536 iterations (dbf
falls through -> bras to the same label).  'tst.b $1000(a1); not.w d0' there turns the
fall-through value into 0.  The SE ROM has no padding to patch in place, so the 6
bytes tst.b/not.w are replaced by a jmp to a stub appended at 0x440000 (the ROM grows
to 320 KiB; the Pi serves $400000-$57FFFF) which does tst.b (acknowledge T2), not.w,
saturates 0 -> 0xFFFF and jumps back to the move.w that stores the result.

patches.name: saturating stubs (appended at 0x440000 / 0x440010)
append_asm: tst.b   %a1@(0x1000)    | read T2C-L: acknowledge the VIA timer 2 interrupt
not.w   %d0             | d0.w = iterations completed (0 if dbf fell through)
